entries.100年のカギをつかった: I used the key of 100 years.
entries.100年の鍵をつかった: I used the key from 100 years ago.
entries.かみつき草の花をつかった: I used the flowers of the biting grass.
entries.奥のカベには ↑と×ボタンで とびつくことができ、\nそのまま上に上がると 奥の:
You can jump onto the wall at the back using the ↑ and × buttons,
and if you go up from there, you can walk along the back line.
To return to the front, do the opposite.
entries.木の枝にぶら下がったときは→で回転\nどんどん速くなる。ジャンプしたい\n方向と:
When hanging from a tree branch → rotate
It gets faster and faster. I want to jump.
Use direction and the × button to jump out!
entries.○ボタンをおしつづけると、\nより強力な攻撃ができる:
If you continue pressing the ○ button,
you can perform a more powerful attack.
entries.人と話すときは ○ボタン: When talking to people, press the ○ button.
entries.ここがセーブポイントです。\n↑で奥を向いているときに\n○を押せばセーブができ:
This is the save point.
When facing backward with ↑,
pressing ○ will save.
entries.この土地は はじめてか?\n\nオレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、\nなんか:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!
entries.よぉ、にィちゃんも\nこの先に行きたいのかい?\n\nそりゃぁムリだ・・・\nこ:
Hey, Niichan too,
do you want to go further?

That's impossible...
Beyond this point, it's completely white.

If the Kiri runs out,
you can go, though...
entries.まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば\n何とかなるみたいだけど・・・\:
Well, according to what I heard, if there's a violent tornado,
it seems like we can manage somehow...
But seriously, where on earth is something like that...?

I've given up!
You should think about it too, big brother...

Goodbye!
entries.オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ\n何か たべるもん ないか?・・・\:
I'm hungry right now and I'm getting irritated.
Is there anything I can eat?...
If not, please save it for later.
entries.オ〜〜〜ッ!\nなんだ それくれるのか?\n\nサンキュー! たすかったゼ\nも:
Ohhhh!
What? You're giving me that?

Thanks! That saved me.
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa—nice to meet you.
entries.そうだ!!\nとっておきの技をおしえてやるョ\n\nいいか?:
That's right!!
I'll teach you my secret technique!

Is that okay?
entries.×ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、\n人よんで ケモノダッシュってい: Pressing the X button while running makes your speed increase—it's called "Kemono Dash," a technique used by humans.
entries.おぼえたか?\n×ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・\nじゃぁオレはいくゼ\n\:
Did you remember?
While pressing the X button...
Well then, I'm off!

Goodbye!
entries.・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!\n\nかくれてたんだけど よくわかった:
...Oh dear... I've already been found!

I was hiding, but you figured it out so well...
entries.よし! いいことおしえてやるよ\n\nこの小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるい:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

If you go straight to the back of this hut, there's a gate,
And if you go up past this hut,
There's an old man called the 100-year-old living there.
entries.え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・\nそんなことより まず行ってみろよ、\nウソ:
Huh?... Is that me?...
Rather than that, first go and see it,
It's not a lie...

After that, let's meet again.
entries.100年老人には会ったのかい?\n\n会ったら また会おうや:
Have you met the 100-year-old?

If you do, let's meet again.
entries.ふるいけ には行ったかい?\n\n行ったら また会おうや:
Did you go to Furuike?

If you did, let's meet again.
entries.どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ\n\nじまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってん:
How about it, it wasn't a lie, right?

It's not a joke, but I know a lot.
entries.・・・あぁ、オイラかい?\n\nオイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・:
...Ah, me?

I'm Yan, from the Hidden Village...
entries.いつも かくれてるんだけど、\nだれも見つけられないんだ・・・\n\nまた見つけ:
I always hide,
but no one can find me...

If I can be found again,
I'll tell you something good then too!
...If I can be found.
entries.う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・\nがんばって見つけてくれよ\n\n:
Hmm... I'm starting to feel like I'm having fun now...
Please do your best to find it!

See ya!
entries.この先に行く気か?\n\nでも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?:
Are you going to go ahead?

But… can you swim?
entries.いかん、いかん\n\n今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが\n次からそうはいかん\:
No, no.

I got help from the turtle this time,
but I can't do that again next time.

Beyond that door,
you can't go unless you can swim...

Don't say bad things,
it's better to stop now...

I'll go when I can swim someday.

Oh, right!
Are you hungry?

Take this!
entries.・・・うーん・・・こまったのォ・・・\n\nどーしたもんかのォ・・・\n\nんっ:
...Hmm... I'm in trouble...

What should I do...?

Hmm?
entries.なんじゃ?・・・\nわしが100年老人じゃが・・・何か用かな?:
What is it?...
I am a 100-year-old old man... Is there something you need?
entries.すまんが、ちょっと\n考えごとをしておってな・・・・・・\n\n・・・おお そう:
Sorry, I'm just thinking about something...

...Oh, that's right!
Hey, would you do me a favor?
What I mean by "favor" is...

You probably saw it when you came here,
that red-breasted chick,

stealing eggs from other places
and then making them his own...

If things continue like this,
the chicks inside will be pitiful...

So, could you gather all the chicks
inside the eggs around here?
entries.しんぱいじゃからな・・・\nたのんだぞ:
I'm worried...
I'm counting on you.
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか?\n\nん〜〜〜っ・・・\nじゃが まだ残っとる:
What? Are they already gathering?

Hmm~~~...
But it seems like there's still some left...

Sorry, could you go again?
entries.集めてくれたのか?・・・\nん〜〜〜っ・・・\n\nじゃが まだ残っとるようじゃ:
Did you collect them?...
Hmmmmm...

But it seems there's still some left...
Sorry, but could you go again?
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか・・・\nおおぉぉぉっ!しかも全部集まっとるではな:
What? Already gathered...?
Ohhhhh! And they're all gathered!
...And where are the contents?
entries.おー・まい・がっ!!\n\nハラの中に入れとったのか!?\n\nまぁ、しかし 消:
Oh my god!!

Did you put it in the stomach!?

Well, but it doesn't seem to be digested,
so I'll leave it at that.

Well, anyway, it was exhausting.
...With this, I can rest easy.

Hmm?...That's right, that's right.
It seems like there was something you wanted from me.

...Hmm...
Did Komabuta take the memento of Ojiisan's arm...?

So, you want to ask about Komabuta and the others...

Hmm, I understand...
Actually, no...
entries.集めてくれたのか?\n\n・・・おぉっ!! 全部集まったようじゃな\n・・・・・:
Did you gather them?

...Oh! It looks like everything's been collected.
...And where are the contents?
entries.わしが 今回、話してやれる事は\nここまでじゃ・・・\n\nん〜〜っ ざんねんじ:
What I can tell you this time is
this far...

Hmm~~, what a shame...

Please enjoy the rest at the product page...

There's plenty of events and actions, so
I'm sure you'll like it...
You should watch the movie after this...

... ...Braver boy,
your adventure has just begun
I'm waiting for you at the product page...
entries.もちろん、わしの力になれることじゃったら\n何でも協力してやるからの・・・\n\:
Of course, if there's anything I can do to help,
I'll cooperate with you...

...That's right,

I have confidence in my abilities, so
if you get something you don't know how to use,
bring it to me...
entries.おや?ないのぉ・・・\nおまえさんに100年のすずを\nやろうとおもったんじゃが:
Oh? It's gone...
I was going to give you a hundred years of tin...

It seems like you lost it somewhere...

If you find something like it,
bring it to me...

In exchange, I'll give you this... Here, take this—it's a hundred-year key.
entries.これで、ここにあるのとおなじ宝箱なら\nあけることができるようになったはずじゃ・:
With this, you should now be able to open the same treasure chests as the ones here...
Hmm, what luck!
entries.それと・・・魔ブタをさがすには、\n封印ぶくろ と呼ばれるモノが必要じゃ・・・\:
And... to find the Demon Pig, you need something called a Seal Pouch...

Without it,
the hiding place becomes invisible...
entries.封印ぶくろのことは、この先の森に住む\nドワーフの長老にきいてみるといい・・・\:
As for the sealed bag, you should ask the elder of the dwarves who live in the forest ahead...
He should be able to tell you more about it.
entries.なんじゃ、わからない物があるなら見せてごらん・・・: What? If there's something you don't understand, show it to me...
entries.・・・おおっ、これはまさしく100年のすず!\nよく見つけたのぉ・・・\n\nこ:
...Oh wow, this is exactly 100 years of Suzu!
You found it well...

If you use this, you should be able to come back here anytime...
entries.カエル水にかえる: The frog returns to the water.
entries.コッカタマゴの中身: The contents of a cockerel egg.
entries.かみつき草の花: The flowers of the biting grass.
entries.かえり道をわすれたカエル: The frog who forgot its way home.
entries.かえられなくなった\nドワーフのこども:
I can't be changed anymore.
Dwarf child.
entries.何でもふき飛ばす\n強力なたつまき:
Blows everything away
A powerful gale
entries.100年老人の小屋へ\nいつでも もどれる:
To the 100-year-old man's cabin,
I can always return.
entries.ある宝箱に合うと\nひらく事ができる:
When it fits into a treasure chest,
you can open it.
entries.一度行った場所へ\nいつでも 行ける:
To a place I once went,
I can always go.
entries.かみつき草にさいた\nめずらしい花:
I planted it in the grass.
A rare flower.
entries.遠くの景色が\n見られる: You can see the distant scenery.
entries.とてもきれいな\nからの小ビン: A very beautiful small bottle from.
entries.涙のつまった小ビン: A small bottle filled with tears.
entries.あしをケガしたこいぬ: A puppy with an injured leg.
entries.枯れ葉の羽を持つ\n伝説のチョウチョ:
A butterfly with wings of withered leaves,
a legendary butterfly.
entries.水がたっぷり\n入ったバケツ: A bucket filled with plenty of water.
entries.なにも うつさないカガミ: A mirror that doesn't reflect anything.
entries.たかい所から\nユラユラおりられる:
From a high place,
you can sway down.
entries.コウテツでできた 強力な\nブーメラン: A powerful boomerang made of kouetsu.
entries.魔ブタを封じこめる\nたいせつな ふくろ:
Sealing the demon pig
A precious pouch
entries.せかいを 見わたす\nべんりな地図: A convenient map that covers the world.
entries.はじめから はいている\nパンツ:
I've been wearing them from the beginning.
Pants.
entries.コマブタにとられた うでわを\nもとめて たびだつ: I'm going to retrieve the arm taken by the pig.
entries.ものしりな100年老人に\n会いに行く: I'm going to meet a knowledgeable 100-year-old.
entries.まどから のぞいている人と\n話しをした: I talked to the person peeking through the window.
entries.おおきな みずたまりの\n話を きいた: I heard a story about a big puddle.
entries.かくれていた人の\nなまえを しった: I learned the name of the person who was hiding.
entries.たまごの なかみを\nあつめる: Gather the contents of the egg.
entries.魔ブタが出たときの\n話を きいた: I heard the story when the demon pig appeared.
entries.森でまいごになった\nこどもを さがす:
Lost in the forest
Searching for a child
entries.森でいなくなった ドワーフたちを さがす: Search for the dwarves who disappeared in the forest.
entries.地下のオオドロボウと話しをする: Talk to the Oodorobou in the basement.
entries.サルのサンタは おなかが すいているようだ\nなにか たべものを さがしてこよう: The monkey Santa seems hungry. Shall I go look for something to eat?
entries.あかの封印ぶくろをつかった: I used the red sealed bag.
entries.水がはいったバケツをつかった: I used a bucket filled with water.
entries.かっとびのパンツをつかった: I used a pair of cuttobi pants.
entries.おおもりべんとうをつかった: I used a large bento box.
entries.森の地下迷路\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→× いいえ→×:
Forest Underground Maze

Save?
Yes → × No → ×
entries.ドワーフの集落の広場\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→× いいえ→×:
Dwarven Village Square

Save?
Yes → × No → ×
entries.わし、けっこうアタマいい\nおまえのコトバわかる・・・けど、\nおまえ、ドワーフ:
I'm pretty smart.
I understand your words... but
you don't understand dwarven words...

If you bite into our words,
you'll remember them...
It might take more than once though...
entries.コ○バ・・・\nわ○○○ない・・・:
Ko-ba...
I don't have a wa-wa-wa...
entries.な○とか ひ△しで\n◎●てきた・・・: I've been doing ◎● with な○ or ひ△...
entries.目のまえで、なかま\nいなくなった・・・: Right before my eyes, my comrade disappeared...
entries.どうしようかねぇ・・・\nあれがないと こまるんだけどねぇ\n・・・おや、きいて:
What should I do...?
I'm in trouble if I don't have that...
...Oh, were you listening?

...Actually... I hid something important in the forest,
but...

There are so many Komabuta in the forest right now,
so I can't go get it...
It's a very important thing though...
entries.森の中に だいじなものを\nかくしておいたんだけど・・・\n\n今の森には、コマ:
I hid something important in the forest,
but...

There are so many Komabuta in the forest now,
so I can't go get it...
It's such an important thing though...
entries.おやっ!これ、とってきてくれたのかい?\nうれしいねぇ・・・えんりょなく いただ:
Oh! Did you bring this for me?
I'm so happy... I'll gladly take it.
...Here it comes! Here it comes!...
entries.・・・ふうーーーっ・・・じつは、\nおなかの中にガスがたまってて\nくるしかった:
...Whew... Actually,
there was gas building up in my stomach
and it was uncomfortable.

Thanks to that, I was saved...
Thank you...
Well, I don't really understand it,
but...

...Instead, please take this.
...It seems to be a rare item.
entries.この先、通さない・・・\nこれ わしのしごと・・・:
I won't let you through from here on out...
This is my job...
entries.ん?なんだ、おまえ\nこれ欲しいのか?\n\n・・・先、あぶないから\nきをつけ:
Hmm? What is it, you?
Do you want this?

...It's dangerous ahead, so
Be careful and take it...
entries.お〜い・・・ だれかいないかぁ〜\n・・・あかりがきれたぞぉ〜:
Hey... Is anyone there?
...The lights are out!
entries.こども!・・・こども見なかったか?\n\nこども、高見ヤグラに 花のたね\nさが:
Child! ... Didn't you see the child?

The child went to Takami Yagura to look for flower seeds... and hasn't come back!

Worried, worried...
Very worried...
entries.・・・あと6人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...six more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと5人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...five more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと4人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...four more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと3人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...Three more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと2人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...two more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あとひとりだけ、\nかえってこない・・・:
...just one more person,
who hasn't come back...
entries.おお!おまえ、こども、たすけてくれたか!\n\nおまえ、とてもやさしいこころもっ:
Oh! You, child, did you help me!

You have a very kind heart... I am very happy.

Take this with you, it will surely be useful.
entries.こども見つけてくれて\nありがとう・・・\nわしとおまえ、ともだち:
Thank you for finding me...
You and I, we're friends.
entries.この花だんにお花咲かせたいなぁ・・・\n\nちょっと前までは、\n森にたくさんの:
I wish I could make flowers bloom in this flowerbed...

Just a little while ago,
there were so many seeds in the forest...

But now they've all withered...

I don't think it's just the evil pig's fault...
entries.もう、お花見れないのかなぁ・・・: I wonder if I'll never be able to see cherry blossoms again...
entries.おまえ、APと書かれた\nへんなモノ見たか?: Did you see something weird that said AP?
entries.わしらのなかま、あれと同じ\nマークの入ったトビラや箱も\n見たこと、あるらしい: It seems our comrades have also seen doors and boxes with the same mark…
entries.どうすれば、ひらくか?\n・・・気になる・・・:
How can I open it?
...I'm curious...
entries.くわしいはなし、ひろばにいる\nなかまがしってる・・・:
Detailed information is available on the forum.
My friends know...
entries.おお、おまえ、ドワーフのことばわかるか!?\nドワーフ、とてもこまってる・・・\:
Oh, you, do you understand the Dwarvish language!?
Dwarves, they're very troubled...

Actually... this Dwarven forest,
is under the spell of the Demon Pig's magic...
The flowers and trees have also changed their forms...

Just now, seven companions were surrounded by monsters in the forest
and became lost...

Probably, inside the larger monsters,
possessed by the Hoshi,
they're unable to move...

Hurry up and open the door near the entrance to the village
and the hut in the forest,
and go deep into the forest, to the very edge...

If you can't find your companions,
they won't let you pass through the forest...
entries.なかま見つからないと、\n森のおく\nとおしてくれないはず・・・:
If you can't find your friends,
they won't let you through the forest...
entries.おお・・・なかま、\nぜんいん助けてくれたか・・・\nほんとうにありがとう:
Oh... comrades,
did you all help me...?
Thank you very much.
entries.ドワーフの長老、\nとてもよろこんでる・・・\nはなし きいてみるといい:
The dwarf elder,
is very pleased...
you should listen to the story.
entries.・・・7人のなかま、かえってきたけど・・・\nじつは、こどもがひとり・・・\n森:
...Seven companions have returned, but...
Actually, one child is missing...
Still lost in the forest...
entries.おまえ、とても、ゆうきある\nドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする:
You, very, have courage.
Dwarf, you, are scared.
entries.勇気ある少年よ・・・\nわしがドワーフの\n長老ですじゃ・・・:
A brave boy...
I am the elder of the dwarves...
entries.7人のドワーフは\nかえってきたんじゃが・・・\n\n子どもがまだ\nかえってこ:
The seven dwarfs
have returned...

But the children
haven't come back yet...
entries.子どもの両親は、この集落の\n入口のちかくの家におる・・・\n話をきいてくれんか:
The child's parents live in a house near the entrance of this village…
Will you listen to what I have to say?
entries.村人代表になりかわり、\n礼を言わせてほしい・・・\n\nなかまをたすけてくれて:
On behalf of the villagers,
I would like to express my gratitude...

Thank you very much for helping my comrades...

Since this is such a small village,
I can't offer much in return...

...That's right...
I heard a story from a 100-year-old man,

that he is watching over the fate of the demon pig...
entries.おぉ、あったあった、\nこれじゃ・・・:
Oh, there it is,
this is...
entries.これは、この森に魔法をかけた魔ブタの\n封印ぶくろ ですじゃ・・・\n\nこれが:
This is the Seal Pouch of the magical pig that cast magic on this forest...

With this, simply approaching where the magical pig is hiding should lead you to the entrance to its hiding place—the Magical Pig Gate...
entries.でも、魔ブタ、\n自分が魔法をかけた場所には\nかくれない・・・:
But the demon pig,
it doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...
entries.それに、魔ブタにはそれぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあり、\n1匹づつ封印できる\n\:
Moreover, each demon pig has its own sealing bag, allowing you to seal them one at a time.
...In other words, you need seven sealing bags for seven demon pigs.
entries.ふくろ、\n魔法をかけられた場所の\nちかくに必ずあるハズ・・・:
A bag,
near the place where magic was cast,
should definitely be there…
entries.魔ブタのゆくえを知りたいのなら、\nそれぞれの 封印ぶくろ をさがすことが\n一:
If you want to know where the Demon Pig is headed,
searching for each of its sealed pouches would be the quickest path...

But... the Demon Pig's power is immense...
Don't try to force it...

You probably don't need to look deep into the forest anymore...
Feel free to pass through freely...
entries.もう、森のおくを\n見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・\n自由に通ってくだされ・・・:
You don't need to look at the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...
entries.魔ブタ・・・\n自分が魔法をかけた場所にはかくれない・・・\n\n封印ぶくろあれ:
Magic pig...
It doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...

If I had a sealing bag,
I could find the magic pig gate...

But each magic pig has
its own sealing bag,
and I can seal them one by one...

In other words, for seven magic pigs,
I need seven sealing bags...

The bag should definitely be near the place where the magic was cast...
entries.ドワーフ、木を切るのとくい・・・\n\nおまえ、わしら助けてくれた・・・\nだか:
Dwarves are skilled at cutting trees...

You helped us...
So if you ever get into trouble,
you should ask one of our comrades...
entries.ん・・・木を切ってほしいのか?\n\nでも、ドワーフが切るのは\nやくめをおえた:
Hmm... do you want me to cut down the tree?

But dwarves only cut down old trees...

For now, I'll follow you...
entries.・・・うん、この木ならだいじょうぶ・・・\nじゃあ、すこしさがって まってろ・・:
...Yeah, this tree will be fine...
Then, go back a little and wait...
entries.おや、あんたも長老をさがしてるのかい?\nこまったねぇ・・・\n\n実は、村のド:
Oh, are you also looking for an elder?
This is troublesome...

Actually, two dwarves from the village have started fighting...
Normally I would just leave them alone, but...

And of all places, they're standing guard at the entrance to the village,
so I can't get out anymore...

...Could you stop them?
entries.長老がいたら、\n一発でおさめてくれるのにねぇ・・・:
If there was an elder,
he would put an end to it in one shot…
entries.うまく かくしたから だいじょうぶ!\n\nそんなの すぐに見つかる・・・\n\:
I wrote it well, so it's okay!

That kind of thing will be found quickly…

After all, I should apologize!
entries.あの2人、長老から\n何かあずかってたらしい・・・: It seems those two received something from the elder…
entries.ほ、ほら・・・やっぱり見つかった!\n\nおまえがわるい!\n\nいや、こわした:
Ho, ho... I found it after all!

It's your fault!

No, you broke it!
entries.ぶわっかもーん!!\nわしの大切なつぼを\nこわすとはなにごとゃ!:
Bwah! What's going on?!
You dare to break my precious pot?!
entries.ふぅ・・・やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・\nおまえさん悪いがこの穴をうめといて:
Phew... I finally managed to get out of this hole...
Sorry, but could you fill this hole back up?

...But who on earth dug this hole anyway...?

...Hmm? What's going on? It's getting noisy outside...
Just as a side note,
...Hey, could you go take a look?
entries.ふぅ・・・おまえさんがなかなか来ないから、\nいちど村にもどってきたんじゃが、\:
Hmm... since you haven't come back for so long,
I returned to the village once,
but I got stuck in this hole splendidly...

Finally, I managed to get out of the hole...

...You,
could you please fill this hole for me?

...But who would dig such a hole...

I'll be waiting in the mountains again...
so don't make me wait too long...
entries.・・・・・・あぁ!お前は!\nぬけ道をふさいじまったガキじゃねえか!\n\n・・:
...Ah! You're!
The kid who blocked the escape route!

...Good grief...
Just as I was about to run away when the pigs were distracted,
they blocked the exit right in front of me...

Thanks to that, I'm back on this street again...
Like a rat caught in a trap...
entries.これじゃぁ屋敷の宝物どころか\nパン一切れさえぬすめやしねえ・・・\n\nくそっ:
This isn't even a treasure of the mansion,
it's not even stealing a slice of bread...

Damn it, I'll show them!
entries.すぴ〜すかかか・・・んがんごっ\n・・・すぴょぴょぴょ・・・:
Supi~ sukaka ka ka... ngan go.
...Supyo pyo pyo pyo...
entries.おや、かわいいボウヤだね。\nでも見たところ元気そうじゃないか・・・\n\nわた:
Oh, what a cute little boy.
But from the looks of it, he seems fine...

I may look like this, but I'm a doctor,
so come see me again if you get hurt.
entries.ボウヤ・・・\nわたしゃこう見えても\nいそがしいんだよ・・・:
Boy...
Even though I look like this,
I'm busy...
entries.みんなを助けてくれたんだって?\nけっこうやるじゃないか・・・ありがとね:
I heard you helped everyone?
You're pretty good at this... thank you.
entries.あんたがケガしたら\nまっ先に見てあげるからね: If you get hurt, I'll be the first to check on you.
entries.おや、どうしたんだいその小鳥・・・\nケガしてるじゃないか!\nちょっと見せてご:
Oh, what's wrong with that little bird...
It's injured!
Let me take a look.

・・・・・・・・・・
・・・This will take a while, huh...

Boy, I'll take care of this little bird for a while...
Don't worry,
I'll take care of it.

・・・Ah, what's the name of this bird?
・・・?
What... at least give it a name...

・・・・・・Baron?・・・I see, Baron.
・・・What a good name!
entries.しばらくしたら また、\n見に来ておくれ: Please come see me again soon.
entries.おまえ、森の外出るのか?\nだったら一度、近道行ってみるといい\n\nとてもキレ:
Are you going outside the forest?
If so, you should try taking a shortcut once.

It's very beautiful... and you can also see a large mansion in the distance.
Rumor has it there are treasures inside too...
You have courage, Kyomi. If you have the chance, you should go.
entries.・・・そういえば、むかし、\n近からこのむらに、魔王きたことある・・・\n\n森:
...Come to think of it, a long time ago,
the Demon King came to this village from near...

A mysterious crystal in the forest, apparently something the Demon King forgot...
Probably, the Demon King knows how to open it...
entries.おまえ、ともだち・・・\nまたあそびにこい:
You, my friend...
Come play again.
entries.おにいちゃん!おにいちゃん!\n・・・お花が咲いたんだよ!:
Big brother! Big brother!
...Flowers have bloomed!
entries.そ○の◎◎の◎◎・・・◎◎に\nつな○△てる・・・もう◎△たか?: That ○○'s ○○... ○○ is connected... Is it already ○○?
entries.◎の◎はあ●ないよ・・・: The ◎ of the ◎ doesn't have a ●...
entries.わ○ら、○ても◎△て○: I'm sorry, but I can't help with that.
entries.森の中、とてもあぶない\n・・・ぜったいダメ!: In the forest, it's very dangerous... absolutely no!
entries.そこの右側の入口・・・\n長老の家につながってる\n\n・・・でも、今みんな\n:
The entrance on the right side over there...
It leads to the elder's house.

...But everyone is busy now...
entries.おおっ! コトバ少し おぼえたか・・・\nでも、まだ かんぜんには わからない\:
Oh! Did you remember a few words...?
But I still don't understand completely.

...Also, if I bite someone alone,
I think I can remember the words...
entries.ここ、ドワーフの村\n・・・なかまいなくなって\nおおさわぎ・・・:
Here, the dwarven village.
...it's no longer worth mentioning.
A great commotion...
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\nなかま、いなくなった!\n\nいま、みんなで 森にある小:
Oh no! Oh no!
My friend is gone!

Right now, everyone is opening the door near the entrance to the village and the cabin in the forest,

and we went looking for the rickety pier and the Takami Yagura...
entries.なかま、木にとりついた\nホウシにつかまって\n木にぶらさがってた・・・\n\n:
A companion, clinging to the tree,
Holding onto a fern,
Hanging from the tree...

When hanging, the fern stretches out
...It's very suspicious...
entries.このへんなキカイ、\n昔からここにある・・・\nわしらには動かせない・・・:
This strange machine,
has been here since ancient times...
we can't move it...
entries.なかまのこと・・・\nとてもしんぱい:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\n何がたいへんって、\nそりゃーもーたいへん!:
Oh dear! Oh dear!
What's so terrible?
Oh my, it's absolutely terrible!
entries.この小屋のこども、\nまだかえってこないらしい:
The child in this hut,
seems to still not have returned.
entries.封印ぶくろ?・・・そういえば、\n森の封印ぶくろとかいうもの\nちょうろうがもっ:
Seal gloves? ... Speaking of which,
there's something called seal gloves in the forest.
Chorou has them...
entries.おまえ、友だち・・・\nまぁ、ゆっくりしていけ:
You, friend...
Well, take your time.
entries.森で、へんなイヌ見た・・・\nおまえ見たか?:
I saw a strange dog in the forest...
Did you see it?
entries.あのイヌ、\nケガしてたんだってな・・・:
That dog,
I heard it was injured...
entries.森の中で こども\n見なかったか?: Didn't you see the child in the forest?
entries.森の中にある恵みの広場\n・・・もう行ったか?:
The bountiful square within the forest...
...Have you already gone?
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・ん?何の見はりか?\n・・・・・それはおしえられない・・・:
I… watch… hmm? What kind of watch?
…I can’t tell you that…
entries.なかま たすけてくれた\n・・・ありがとう: My friend helped me... thank you.
entries.そう言えば・・・\n始まりの森のかみつき草にも\n花が咲くらしい・・・\n\nで:
Come to think of it...
I hear flowers bloom on the biting grass in the forest of beginnings...

But we've never seen them...
entries.キノコの森を右側にぬけた先に\n山がある・・・でも、\nとてもキケンな山・・・: Beyond the mushroom forest on the right lies a mountain... but it's a very dangerous one...
entries.キノコの森には、\nいろんなキノコはえてるけど\nむやみに食べない方がいい:
In the mushroom forest,
there are various mushrooms growing,
but it's better not to eat them recklessly.
entries.高見ヤグラのぼうえんきょう、もう見たか?\nあそこのけしき、とてもキレイ・・・:
Have you seen the Noboru Kyo of Takami Yagura yet?
That scenery over there is very beautiful...
entries.このキカイこわれてる・・・\n\nたまに来る、赤い服をきたヤツなら\nなおせるか:
This machine is broken...

If it's the guy who comes occasionally wearing a red outfit,
I might be able to fix it.
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・\nちょっとたいへん・・・:
I... I'm a lookout...
It's a little difficult...
entries.わしらの◎◎、いなくな△た・・・\n◎は◎に◎ないほう●いい・・・:
Our ◎◎ has disappeared…
It's better if ◎ doesn't exist…
entries.わしらのなかま、いなくなった・・・\n今は森に出ないほうがいい・・・:
Our comrades have disappeared…
It's better not to go into the forest now…
entries.わしらの長老にはもう会ったか?: Have you met our elder yet?
entries.たき先といえば・・・\n・・・・・・ヤキイモだねぇ・・・\n\nそういえば、\n:
Speaking of firewood...
...It's yakiimo, huh...

Come to think of it,
there's a nice smell in the forest, you know...
entries.おやっ!\n・・・これ、くれるのかい?\nうれしいねぇ・・・\n\nそうだ、何か:
Oh!
...Is this what you're giving me?
I'm so happy...

Well, I don't really understand what's going on, but...
Please take this instead.
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅう・・・ぜんぶ見たか?:
Hanging from a sharp tree.
Houshi manju... Have you seen them all?
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅうの中に\nなかま2人 とりこまれ:
Hanging from a sharp tree,
inside a hōshi manju,
two companions were captivated.
entries.ユラユラゆれるホウシダマ・・・\nとてもあやしい・・・:
The swaying fern...
It's very suspicious...
entries.ホウシダマがかぶさっている\n木の先のなかま、2人いるハズ・・・:
The houjidama is overlapping.
There should be two people among the tips of the trees…
entries.グラグラさんばしに なかまひとり\nつかまってた・・・: I was caught by Guragura-sanbashi, with one companion.
entries.高見ヤグラ・・・ひろくてたいへん\n・・・なかま見つけにくい・・・\n回復する液:
Takami Yagura... It's wide and difficult.
... It's hard to find companions...
Recovery liquid, if you don't use it well...
entries.たしか高見ヤグラに2人のなかま\nつかまっているハズ: I'm sure there are two of them trapped in Takami Yagura.
entries.たき先といえば・・・・・・\nヤキイモだねぇ・・・:
Speaking of the tip...
It's a yakimo, huh...
entries.こども・・・森から\nまだかえってこないらしい・・・:
Children... from the forest.
It seems they haven't returned yet...
entries.そういえば、高見ヤグラで\nこどものこえ きこえたような・・・:
Come to think of it, at Takami Yagura,
I think I heard a child's voice...
entries.ドワーフの長老、\nとても よろこんでる:
The dwarf elder,
is very pleased.
entries.あくしゅ してほしい・・・: I want you to shake hands...
entries.地下ロウの大ドロボウ: The Great Robbery of the Underground Row
entries.とびっきりの泣きがお?: Is there a particularly big cry?

messages.original: あばれ竜巻をつかった

messages.translation: I used the key of 100 years.
I used the key from 100 years ago.

messages.original: めぐみの羽根をつかった
かみつき草の花をつかった
messages.translation: I used the flowers of the biting grass.

messages.original: ライフゲージかくだい

奥のカベには ↑と×ボタンで とびつくことができ、
そのまま上に上がると 奥のラインを歩けるよ
手前にもどりたいときはその逆だよ
messages.translation:
You can jump onto the wall at the back using the ↑ and × buttons,
and if you go up from there, you can walk along the back line.
To return to the front, do the opposite.

messages.original:
木の枝にぶら下がったときは→で回転
どんどん速くなる。ジャンプしたい
方向と×ボタンで飛び出す!
messages.translation:
When hanging from a tree branch → rotate
It gets faster and faster. I want to jump.
Use direction and the × button to jump out!

messages.original:
○ボタンをおしつづけると、
より強力な攻撃ができる
messages.translation:
If you continue pressing the ○ button,
you can perform a more powerful attack.

messages.original: 人と話すときは ○ボタン
messages.translation: When talking to people, press the ○ button.

messages.original:
ここがセーブポイントです。
↑で奥を向いているときに
○を押せばセーブができます
messages.translation:
This is the save point.
When facing backward with ↑,
pressing ○ will save.

messages.original:
この土地は はじめてか?

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

でも、このあたりもあぶなくなったから
気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と○ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!

messages.original:
よぉ、にィちゃんも
この先に行きたいのかい?

そりゃぁムリだ・・・
この先はキリで まっ白だぜ

キリがなくなりゃぁ
行けるんだけどな・・・
messages.translation:
Hey, Niichan too,
do you want to go further?

That's impossible...
Beyond this point, it's completely white.

If the Kiri runs out,
you can go, though...

messages.original:
まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば
何とかなるみたいだけど・・・
じっさい どこにあるんだよ、そんなもん・・・

オレは あきらめた!
にぃちゃんも考えた方がいいぜ・・・

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Well, according to what I heard, if there's a violent tornado,
it seems like we can manage somehow...
But seriously, where on earth is something like that...?

I've given up!
You should think about it too, big brother...

Goodbye!

messages.original:
オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ
何か たべるもん ないか?・・・
なけりゃ またあとにしてくれョ
messages.translation:
I'm hungry right now and I'm getting irritated.
Is there anything I can eat?...
If not, please save it for later.

messages.original:
オ〜〜〜ッ!
なんだ それくれるのか?

サンキュー! たすかったゼ
もう ハラがへって、うごけなかったんだ

オレ サンタ ってんだ、よろしくな
messages.translation:
Ohhhh!
What? You're giving me that?

Thanks! That saved me.
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa—nice to meet you.

messages.original:
そうだ!!
とっておきの技をおしえてやるョ

いいか?
messages.translation:
That's right!!
I'll teach you my secret technique!

Is that okay?

messages.original:
×ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、
人よんで ケモノダッシュっていう技だゼ
messages.translation: Pressing the X button while running makes your speed increase—it's called "Kemono Dash," a technique used by humans.

messages.original:
おぼえたか?
×ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・
じゃぁオレはいくゼ

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Did you remember?
While pressing the X button...
Well then, I'm off!

Goodbye!

messages.original:
・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!

かくれてたんだけど よくわかったな・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh dear... I've already been found!

I was hiding, but you figured it out so well...

messages.original:
よし! いいことおしえてやるよ

この小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるいけ、
そして、この小屋の先を上に行くと
100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ
messages.translation:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

If you go straight to the back of this hut, there's a gate,
And if you go up past this hut,
There's an old man called the 100-year-old living there.

messages.original:
え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・
そんなことより まず行ってみろよ、
ウソじゃないから・・・

そのあとで また会おうや
messages.translation:
Huh?... Is that me?...
Rather than that, first go and see it,
It's not a lie...

After that, let's meet again.

messages.original: えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・

100年老人には会ったのかい?

会ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you met the 100-year-old?

If you do, let's meet again.

messages.original:
ふるいけ には行ったかい?

行ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Did you go to Furuike?

If you did, let's meet again.

messages.original:
どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ

じまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってんだ
messages.translation:
How about it, it wasn't a lie, right?

It's not a joke, but I know a lot.

messages.original:
・・・あぁ、オイラかい?

オイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・
messages.translation:
...Ah, me?

I'm Yan, from the Hidden Village...

messages.original:
いつも かくれてるんだけど、
だれも見つけられないんだ・・・

また見つけられたら そのときも
いいことおしえてやるよ!
・・・見つけることができたらな
messages.translation:
I always hide,
but no one can find me...

If I can be found again,
I'll tell you something good then too!
...If I can be found.

messages.original:
う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・
がんばって見つけてくれよ

じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Hmm... I'm starting to feel like I'm having fun now...
Please do your best to find it!

See ya!

messages.original:
この先に行く気か?

でも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?
messages.translation:
Are you going to go ahead?

But… can you swim?

messages.original:
いかん、いかん

今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが
次からそうはいかん

そこのトビラの先は
泳げないと行けんのだから・・・

悪いことはいわん、
今はやめた方がいい・・・

いつか 泳げるようになってから行くんだナ

おっ そうだ!
おまえ ハラへってないかィ?

これ もってけよ!
messages.translation:
No, no.

I got help from the turtle this time,
but I can't do that again next time.

Beyond that door,
you can't go unless you can swim...

Don't say bad things,
it's better to stop now...

I'll go when I can swim someday.

Oh, right!
Are you hungry?

Take this!

messages.original: じゃあなボウズ 気ィつけて行けや

・・・うーん・・・こまったのォ・・・

どーしたもんかのォ・・・

んっ?
messages.translation:
...Hmm... I'm in trouble...

What should I do...?

Hmm?

messages.original:
なんじゃ?・・・
わしが100年老人じゃが・・・何か用かな?
messages.translation:
What is it?...
I am a 100-year-old old man... Is there something you need?

messages.original:
すまんが、ちょっと
考えごとをしておってな・・・・・・

・・・おお そうじゃ!!
ちょっと おまえさん、たのまれてくれんか?
たのみというのはのォ・・・

おまえさんも ここへ来るとき 見たと思うが、
赤いトリのコッカのやつめ、

よそからタマゴを盗んできては、
ああやって自分のものにしておってな・・・

あのままでは
中のヒナが かわいそうなんじゃ・・・

そこでおまえさん、このへんにあるタマゴの中にいる
ヒナを全部 集めてくれんか?
messages.translation:
Sorry, I'm just thinking about something...

...Oh, that's right!
Hey, would you do me a favor?
What I mean by "favor" is...

You probably saw it when you came here,
that red-breasted chick,

stealing eggs from other places
and then making them his own...

If things continue like this,
the chicks inside will be pitiful...

So, could you gather all the chicks
inside the eggs around here?

messages.original:
しんぱいじゃからな・・・
たのんだぞ
messages.translation:
I'm worried...
I'm counting on you.

messages.original:
なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか?

ん〜〜〜っ・・・
じゃが まだ残っとるようじゃのォ・・・

すまんがもう一度 行ってくれんか?
messages.translation:
What? Are they already gathering?

Hmm~~~...
But it seems like there's still some left...

Sorry, could you go again?

messages.original:
集めてくれたのか?・・・
ん〜〜〜っ・・・

じゃが まだ残っとるようじゃのォ・・・
すまんがもう一度 行ってくれんか?
messages.translation:
Did you collect them?...
Hmmmmm...

But it seems there's still some left...
Sorry, but could you go again?

messages.original:
なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか・・・
おおぉぉぉっ!しかも全部集まっとるではないか!
・・・・・・で、中身はどこじゃ?
messages.translation:
What? Already gathered...?
Ohhhhh! And they're all gathered!
...And where are the contents?

messages.original:

・・・7人のなかま、かえってきたけど・・・
じつは、こどもがひとり・・・
森のなかで迷子になったまま・・・
messages.translation:
...Seven companions have returned, but...
Actually, one child is missing...
Still lost in the forest...

messages.original:
おまえ、とても、ゆうきある
ドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする
messages.translation:
You, very, have courage.
Dwarf, you, are scared.

messages.original:
勇気ある少年よ・・・
わしがドワーフの
長老ですじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
A brave boy...
I am the elder of the dwarves...

messages.original:
7人のドワーフは
かえってきたんじゃが・・・

子どもがまだ
かえってこないんじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
The seven dwarfs
have returned...

But the children
haven't come back yet...

messages.original:
子どもの両親は、この集落の
入口のちかくの家におる・・・
話をきいてくれんかのぅ・・
messages.translation:
The child's parents live in a house near the entrance of this village…
Will you listen to what I have to say?

messages.original:
村人代表になりかわり、
礼を言わせてほしい・・・

なかまをたすけてくれて
本当にありがとう・・・

こんな村じゃから、
たいしたお礼も
できないんじゃが・・・

・・・そうじゃ・・・
100年老人から話は
聞いたんじゃが、

魔ブタのゆくえを
おっているとか・・・
messages.translation:
On behalf of the villagers,
I would like to express my gratitude...

Thank you very much for helping my comrades...

Since this is such a small village,
I can't offer much in return...

...That's right...
I heard a story from a 100-year-old man,

that he is watching over the fate of the demon pig...

messages.original:
おぉ、あったあった、
これじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
Oh, there it is,
this is...

messages.original:
これは、この森に魔法をかけた魔ブタの
封印ぶくろ ですじゃ・・・

これがあれば魔ブタのかくれている場所へ近づくだけで、
かくれ場所への入口、すなわち魔ブタゲートを
見つけてくれるハズじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
This is the Seal Pouch of the magical pig that cast magic on this forest...

With this, simply approaching where the magical pig is hiding should lead you to the entrance to its hiding place—the Magical Pig Gate...

messages.original:
でも、魔ブタ、
自分が魔法をかけた場所には
かくれない・・・
messages.translation:
But the demon pig,
it doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...

messages.original:
それに、魔ブタにはそれぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあり、
1匹づつ封印できる

・・・つまり、7匹の魔ブタに対して
7つの封印ぶくろが必要なわけじゃ
messages.translation:
Moreover, each demon pig has its own sealing bag, allowing you to seal them one at a time.
...In other words, you need seven sealing bags for seven demon pigs.

messages.original:
ふくろ、
魔法をかけられた場所の
ちかくに必ずあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
A bag,
near the place where magic was cast,
should definitely be there…

messages.original:
魔ブタのゆくえを知りたいのなら、
それぞれの 封印ぶくろ をさがすことが
一番の近道じゃろう・・・

しかし・・・魔ブタの力は強大じゃ・・・
ムリはせんようにな・・・

もう、森のおくを見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・
自由に通ってくだされ・・・
messages.translation:
If you want to know where the Demon Pig is headed,
searching for each of its sealed pouches would be the quickest path...

But... the Demon Pig's power is immense...
Don't try to force it...

You probably don't need to look deep into the forest anymore...
Feel free to pass through freely...

messages.original:
もう、森のおくを
見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・
自由に通ってくだされ・・・
messages.translation:
You don't need to look at the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...

messages.original:
魔ブタ・・・
自分が魔法をかけた場所にはかくれない・・・

封印ぶくろあれば
魔ブタゲート見つけることできる・・・

でも、魔ブタには
それぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあって、
1匹づつ封印できる・・・

つまり、7匹の魔ブタに対して
7つの封印ぶくろ ひつよう・・・

ふくろ、魔法をかけられた場所のちかくに
必ずあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
Magic pig...
It doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...

If I had a sealing bag,
I could find the magic pig gate...

But each magic pig has
its own sealing bag,
and I can seal them one by one...

In other words, for seven magic pigs,
I need seven sealing bags...

The bag should definitely be near the place where the magic was cast...

messages.original:
ドワーフ、木を切るのとくい・・・

おまえ、わしら助けてくれた・・・
だからおまえも困ったことあったら、
わしらの なかまにたのむといい・・・
messages.translation:
Dwarves are skilled at cutting trees...

You helped us...
So if you ever get into trouble,
you should ask one of our comrades...

messages.original:
ん・・・木を切ってほしいのか?

でも、ドワーフが切るのは
やくめをおえた ふるい木だけ・・・

とりあえず、おまえのあとついていく・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm... do you want me to cut down the tree?

But dwarves only cut down old trees...

For now, I'll follow you...

messages.original:
・・・うん、この木ならだいじょうぶ・・・
じゃあ、すこしさがって まってろ・・・
messages.translation:
...Yeah, this tree will be fine...
Then, go back a little and wait...

messages.original:
おや、あんたも長老をさがしてるのかい?
こまったねぇ・・・

実は、村のドワーフ2人が
ケンカをはじめちやってね・・・
いつもだったら、ほっとくんだけど・・・

よりによって、村の入り口でもみ張ってるから、
外に出られなくなっちゃったんだ・・・

・・・あんた、とめてくれないかい?
messages.translation:
Oh, are you also looking for an elder?
This is troublesome...

Actually, two dwarves from the village have started fighting...
Normally I would just leave them alone, but...

And of all places, they're standing guard at the entrance to the village,
so I can't get out anymore...

...Could you stop them?

messages.original:
長老がいたら、
一発でおさめてくれるのにねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
If there was an elder,
he would put an end to it in one shot…

messages.original:
うまく かくしたから だいじょうぶ!

そんなの すぐに見つかる・・・

やっぱり、あやまったほうがいい!
messages.translation:
I wrote it well, so it's okay!

That kind of thing will be found quickly…

After all, I should apologize!

messages.original:
何か こわしたとか
なんとか・・・

あの2人、長老から
何かあずかってたらしい・・・
messages.translation: It seems those two received something from the elder…

messages.original:
ほ、ほら・・・やっぱり見つかった!

おまえがわるい!

いや、こわしたのは おまえ!
messages.translation:
Ho, ho... I found it after all!

It's your fault!

No, you broke it!

messages.original:
ぶわっかもーん!!
わしの大切なつぼを
こわすとはなにごとゃ!
messages.translation:
Bwah! What's going on?!
You dare to break my precious pot?!

messages.original: ご、ごめんなさーい・・・

ふぅ・・・やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・
おまえさん悪いがこの穴をうめといてくれんか?

・・・しかし、だれがこんな穴をほったんじゃろうな・・・

・・・ん?なんじゃ?なんだか外がさわがしいのぉ・・・
ことのついでじゃ
・・・おまえさん ちょっと見てきてくれんか?
messages.translation:
Phew... I finally managed to get out of this hole...
Sorry, but could you fill this hole back up?

...But who on earth dug this hole anyway...?

...Hmm? What's going on? It's getting noisy outside...
Just as a side note,
...Hey, could you go take a look?

messages.original:
ふぅ・・・おまえさんがなかなか来ないから、
いちど村にもどってきたんじゃが、
この穴にみごとにハマってのぉ・・・

やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・

・・・おまえさん、
悪いがこの穴をうめといてくれんか?

・・・しかし、だれがこんな穴を
ほったんじゃろうな・・・

わしはまた、山でまっておるからの・・・
あまり、としよりをまたせるでないぞ・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm... since you haven't come back for so long,
I returned to the village once,
but I got stuck in this hole splendidly...

Finally, I managed to get out of the hole...

...You,
could you please fill this hole for me?

...But who would dig such a hole...

I'll be waiting in the mountains again...
so don't make me wait too long...

messages.original:
・・・・・・あぁ!お前は!
ぬけ道をふさいじまったガキじゃねえか!

・・・ったく・・・
コマブタ達のすきを見てにげ出そうとしたら、
目の前で出口をふさいじまいやがって・・・

おかげでこの通り、
また ろうやにぎゃく戻りさ・・・
messages.translation:
...Ah! You're!
The kid who blocked the escape route!

...Good grief...
Just as I was about to run away when the pigs were distracted,
they blocked the exit right in front of me...

Thanks to that, I'm back on this street again...
Like a rat caught in a trap...

messages.original:
これじゃぁ屋敷の宝物どころか
パン一切れさえぬすめやしねえ・・・

くそっ、ふてねしてやる!
messages.translation:
This isn't even a treasure of the mansion,
it's not even stealing a slice of bread...

Damn it, I'll show them!

messages.original:
すぴ〜すかかか・・・んがんごっ
・・・すぴょぴょぴょ・・・
messages.translation:
Supi~ sukaka ka ka... ngan go.
...Supyo pyo pyo pyo...

messages.original:
おや、かわいいボウヤだね。
でも見たところ元気そうじゃないか・・・

わたしゃこう見えても医者だからね、
ケガでもしたらまたおいで
messages.translation:
Oh, what a cute little boy.
But from the looks of it, he seems fine...

I may look like this, but I'm a doctor,
so come see me again if you get hurt.

messages.original:
ボウヤ・・・
わたしゃこう見えても
いそがしいんだよ・・・
messages.translation:
Boy...
Even though I look like this,
I'm busy...

messages.original:
みんなを助けてくれたんだって?
けっこうやるじゃないか・・・ありがとね
messages.translation:
I heard you helped everyone?
You're pretty good at this... thank you.

messages.original:
あんたがケガしたら
まっ先に見てあげるからね
messages.translation: If you get hurt, I'll be the first to check on you.

messages.original:
おや、どうしたんだいその小鳥・・・
ケガしてるじゃないか!
ちょっと見せてごらん

・・・・・・・・・・
・・・これはちょっとじかんがかかりそうだね・・・

ボウヤ、この小鳥しばらく私があずかるよ・・・
なぁに心配はいらないよ、
わたしがせきにんもって みるからさ

・・・あぁ、この鳥なんて名前だい?
・・・・?
なんだい・・・名前ぐらい付けてあげなよ・・・

・・・・・・バロン?・・・そうか、バロンか
・・・いい名前じゃないか!
messages.translation:
Oh, what's wrong with that little bird...
It's injured!
Let me take a look.

・・・・・・・・・・
・・・This will take a while, huh...

Boy, I'll take care of this little bird for a while...
Don't worry,
I'll take care of it.

・・・Ah, what's the name of this bird?
・・・?
What... at least give it a name...

・・・・・・Baron?・・・I see, Baron.
・・・What a good name!

messages.original:
しばらくしたら また、
見に来ておくれ
messages.translation: Please come see me again soon.

messages.original:
おまえ、森の外出るのか?
だったら一度、近道行ってみるといい

とてもキレイ・・・とおくに大きな屋敷も見える
ウワサでは宝物もあるらしい・・・
おまえ、勇気ある、キョウミあったら行ってみるといい
messages.translation:
Are you going outside the forest?
If so, you should try taking a shortcut once.

It's very beautiful... and you can also see a large mansion in the distance.
Rumor has it there are treasures inside too...
You have courage, Kyomi. If you have the chance, you should go.

messages.original:
・・・そういえば、むかし、
近からこのむらに、魔王きたことある・・・

森にあるふしぎな水晶、魔王のわすれものらしい・・・
たぶん、開けかたは魔王が知ってる・・・
messages.translation:
...Come to think of it, a long time ago,
the Demon King came to this village from near...

A mysterious crystal in the forest, apparently something the Demon King forgot...
Probably, the Demon King knows how to open it...

messages.original:
おまえ、ともだち・・・
またあそびにこい
messages.translation:
You, my friend...
Come play again.

messages.original:
おにいちゃん!おにいちゃん!
・・・お花が咲いたんだよ!
messages.translation:
Big brother! Big brother!
...Flowers have bloomed!

messages.original: たいへんだ!たいへんだぁ!
たいへんだ!たいへんだぁ!

そ○の◎◎の◎◎・・・◎◎に
つな○△てる・・・もう◎△たか?
messages.translation: That ○○'s ○○... ○○ is connected... Is it already ○○?

messages.original:
◎のまえ●、◎◎
いなくな△た・・・

な○とか ひ△しで
◎●てきた・・・
messages.translation: I've been doing ◎● with な○ or ひ△...
The ◎ of the ◎ doesn't have a ●...
I'm sorry, but I can't help with that.
I'm sorry, but I can't help with that.

messages.original: な○まの○と・・・とても○ん◎い

な○まの○と・・・
と○も○ん◎い
ねぇ、行ってもいいでしょ・・・

森の中、とてもあぶない
・・・ぜったいダメ!
messages.translation: In the forest, it's very dangerous... absolutely no!

messages.original:
そこの右側の入口・・・
長老の家につながってる

・・・でも、今みんな
いそがしい・・・
messages.translation:
The entrance on the right side over there...
It leads to the elder's house.

...But everyone is busy now...

messages.original:
おおっ! コトバ少し おぼえたか・・・
でも、まだ かんぜんには わからない

・・・あと、ひとりに かみつけば
たぶんコトバおぼえられる・・・
messages.translation:
Oh! Did you remember a few words...?
But I still don't understand completely.

...Also, if I bite someone alone,
I think I can remember the words...

messages.original:
ここ、ドワーフの村
・・・なかまいなくなって
おおさわぎ・・・
messages.translation:
Here, the dwarven village.
...it's no longer worth mentioning.
A great commotion...

messages.original:
たいへん!たいへん!
なかま、いなくなった!

いま、みんなで 森にある小屋と
村の入口ちかくのとびらをあけて、

グラグラ桟橋と、高見ヤグラに
さがしにいったところ・・・
messages.translation:
Oh no! Oh no!
My friend is gone!

Right now, everyone is opening the door near the entrance to the village and the cabin in the forest,

and we went looking for the rickety pier and the Takami Yagura...

messages.original:
目のまえで、なかま
いなくなった・・・
messages.translation: Right before my eyes, my comrade disappeared...

messages.original:
なかま、木にとりついた
ホウシにつかまって
木にぶらさがってた・・・

ぶらさがると のびるホウシダマ
・・・とても あやしい・・・
messages.translation:
A companion, clinging to the tree,
Holding onto a fern,
Hanging from the tree...

When hanging, the fern stretches out
...It's very suspicious...

messages.original:
このへんなキカイ、
昔からここにある・・・
わしらには動かせない・・・
messages.translation:
This strange machine,
has been here since ancient times...
we can't move it...

messages.original: わし・・・長老のいちばんでし

なんとか ひっしで
にげてきた・・・

なかまのこと・・・
とてもしんぱい
messages.translation:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.

messages.original:
たいへん!たいへん!
何がたいへんって、
そりゃーもーたいへん!
messages.translation:
Oh dear! Oh dear!
What's so terrible?
Oh my, it's absolutely terrible!

messages.original:
この小屋のこども、
まだかえってこないらしい
messages.translation:
The child in this hut,
seems to still not have returned.

messages.original:
封印ぶくろ?・・・そういえば、
森の封印ぶくろとかいうもの
ちょうろうがもってる・・・
messages.translation:
Seal gloves? ... Speaking of which,
there's something called seal gloves in the forest.
Chorou has them...

messages.original:
おまえ、友だち・・・
まぁ、ゆっくりしていけ
messages.translation:
You, friend...
Well, take your time.

messages.original:
森で、へんなイヌ見た・・・
おまえ見たか?
messages.translation:
I saw a strange dog in the forest...
Did you see it?

messages.original:
あのイヌ、
ケガしてたんだってな・・・
messages.translation:
That dog,
I heard it was injured...

messages.original:
森の中で こども
見なかったか?
messages.translation: Didn't you see the child in the forest?

messages.original:
森の中にある恵みの広場
・・・もう行ったか?
messages.translation:
The bountiful square within the forest...
...Have you already gone?

messages.original:
こどものこと・・・
とてもしんぱい

わし・・・見はり・・・ん?何の見はりか?
・・・・・それはおしえられない・・・
messages.translation:
I… watch… hmm? What kind of watch?
…I can’t tell you that…

messages.original: 長老にはもうあったか?

なかま たすけてくれた
・・・ありがとう
messages.translation: My friend helped me... thank you.

messages.original:
そう言えば・・・
始まりの森のかみつき草にも
花が咲くらしい・・・

でも、わしら見たことない・・・
messages.translation:
Come to think of it...
I hear flowers bloom on the biting grass in the forest of beginnings...

But we've never seen them...

messages.original:
キノコの森を右側にぬけた先に
山がある・・・でも、
とてもキケンな山・・・
messages.translation: Beyond the mushroom forest on the right lies a mountain... but it's a very dangerous one...

messages.original:
キノコの森には、
いろんなキノコはえてるけど
むやみに食べない方がいい
messages.translation:
In the mushroom forest,
there are various mushrooms growing,
but it's better not to eat them recklessly.

messages.original:
高見ヤグラのぼうえんきょう、もう見たか?
あそこのけしき、とてもキレイ・・・
messages.translation:
Have you seen the Noboru Kyo of Takami Yagura yet?
That scenery over there is very beautiful...

messages.original:
このキカイこわれてる・・・

たまに来る、赤い服をきたヤツなら
なおせるかもしれない
messages.translation:
This machine is broken...

If it's the guy who comes occasionally wearing a red outfit,
I might be able to fix it.

messages.original:
わし・・・見はり・・・
ちょっとたいへん・・・
messages.translation:
I... I'm a lookout...
It's a little difficult...

messages.original:
わしらの◎◎、いなくな△た・・・
◎は◎に◎ないほう●いい・・・
messages.translation:
Our ◎◎ has disappeared…
It's better if ◎ doesn't exist…

messages.original: わしらの◎◎にはもう◎△たか?

わしらのなかま、いなくなった・・・
今は森に出ないほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
Our comrades have disappeared…
It's better not to go into the forest now…

messages.original: わしらの長老にはもう会ったか?
messages.translation: Have you met our elder yet?

messages.original:
たき先といえば・・・
・・・・・・ヤキイモだねぇ・・・

そういえば、
森の中でいいニオイがするんだけどねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
Speaking of firewood...
...It's yakiimo, huh...

Come to think of it,
there's a nice smell in the forest, you know...

messages.original:
おやっ!
・・・これ、くれるのかい?
うれしいねぇ・・・

そうだ、何かわからないんだけど・・・
かわりに これをもらっとくれ
messages.translation:
Oh!
...Is this what you're giving me?
I'm so happy...

Well, I don't really understand what's going on, but...
Please take this instead.

messages.original:
ケガしてるね・・・
かわいそう・・・

とがった木にぶら下がっている
ホウシまんじゅう・・・ぜんぶ見たか?
messages.translation:
Hanging from a sharp tree.
Houshi manju... Have you seen them all?

messages.original:
とがった木にぶら下がっている
ホウシまんじゅうの中に
なかま2人 とりこまれた
messages.translation:
Hanging from a sharp tree,
inside a hōshi manju,
two companions were captivated.

messages.original:
ユラユラゆれるホウシダマ・・・
とてもあやしい・・・
messages.translation:
The swaying fern...
It's very suspicious...

messages.original:
ホウシダマがかぶさっている
木の先のなかま、2人いるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
The houjidama is overlapping.
There should be two people among the tips of the trees…

messages.original:
グラグラさんばしに なかまひとり
つかまってた・・・
messages.translation: I was caught by Guragura-sanbashi, with one companion.

messages.original:
高見ヤグラ・・・ひろくてたいへん
・・・なかま見つけにくい・・・
回復する液、うまくつかわないと・・・
messages.translation:
Takami Yagura... It's wide and difficult.
... It's hard to find companions...
Recovery liquid, if you don't use it well...

messages.original:
たしか高見ヤグラに2人のなかま
つかまっているハズ
messages.translation: I'm sure there are two of them trapped in Takami Yagura.

messages.original:
たき先といえば・・・・・・
ヤキイモだねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
Speaking of the tip...
It's a yakimo, huh...

messages.original:
ドワーフ、とても
かんしゃしてる

こども・・・森から
まだかえってこないらしい・・・
messages.translation:
Children... from the forest.
It seems they haven't returned yet...

messages.original:
そういえば、高見ヤグラで
こどものこえ きこえたような・・・
messages.translation:
Come to think of it, at Takami Yagura,
I think I heard a child's voice...
